+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_BASE = "https://api.openai.com/v1"
+DEFAULT_MODEL = "gpt-4o-transcribe"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class SpeechClientConfig:
+    api_key: str
+    base_url: str = OPENAI_API_BASE
+    model: str = DEFAULT_MODEL
+
+
+def load_speech_client_config(*, api_key: Optional[str] = None, base_url: Optional[str] = None, model: Optional[str] = None) -> SpeechClientConfig:
+    resolved_api_key = api_key or os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not resolved_api_key:
+        raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+    return SpeechClientConfig(
+        api_key=resolved_api_key,
+        base_url=base_url or os.getenv("OPENAI_API_BASE", OPENAI_API_BASE),
+        model=model or os.getenv("OPENAI_SPEECH_MODEL", DEFAULT_MODEL),
+    )
+
+
+def build_speech_headers(config: SpeechClientConfig) -> Dict[str, str]:
+    return {
+        "Authorization": f"Bearer {config.api_key}",
+        "Content-Type": "application/json",
+    }
+
+
+def openai_transcription_endpoint(config: SpeechClientConfig) -> str:
+    return f"{config.base_url.rstrip('/')}/audio/transcriptions"
+
+
+def create_batch_speech_client(*, api_key: Optional[str] = None, base_url: Optional[str] = None, model: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    config = load_speech_client_config(api_key=api_key, base_url=base_url, model=model)
+    return {
+        "config": config,
+        "headers": build_speech_headers(config),
+        "endpoint": openai_transcription_endpoint(config),
+        "session": requests.Session(),
+    }
+
*** End Patch

+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from assemblyai import Transcriber, TranscriptionConfig
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
+        return 1
+    audio_path = Path(sys.argv[1])
+    if not audio_path.exists():
+        return 1
+    api_key = os.environ.get("ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        return 1
+    os.environ["ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY"] = api_key
+    transcriber = Transcriber()
+    config = TranscriptionConfig(speaker_labels=True)
+    transcript = transcriber.transcribe(str(audio_path), config=config)
+    utterances = []
+    for utterance in getattr(transcript, "utterances", []) or []:
+        utterances.append({"speaker": utterance.speaker, "text": utterance.text, "start": utterance.start, "end": utterance.end})
+    print(json.dumps({"text": transcript.text, "utterances": utterances}, ensure_ascii=False))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())

+import argparse
+import base64
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+import urllib.error
+import urllib.request
+
+
+def submit_transcription(audio_path: str, model: str = "gpt-4o-transcribe") -> dict:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    with open(audio_path, "rb") as f:
+        audio_bytes = f.read()
+
+    payload = {
+        "model": model,
+        "input": [
+            {
+                "type": "input_audio",
+                "input_audio": {
+                    "data": base64.b64encode(audio_bytes).decode("ascii"),
+                    "format": os.path.splitext(audio_path)[1].lstrip(".").lower() or "mp3",
+                },
+            }
+        ],
+    }
+
+    request = urllib.request.Request(
+        "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses",
+        data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        method="POST",
+    )
+
+    try:
+        with urllib.request.urlopen(request) as response:
+            return json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
+    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
+        body = e.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
+        raise RuntimeError(f"OpenAI API request failed: {e.code} {body}") from e
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Submit an audio file for batch transcription using OpenAI.")
+    parser.add_argument("audio_file")
+    parser.add_argument("--model", default="gpt-4o-transcribe")
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+
+    result = submit_transcription(args.audio_file, args.model)
+    json.dump(result, sys.stdout, indent=2)
+    sys.stdout.write("\n")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
*** End Patch
